source_text: Omnem locum quemcumque adscenderitis vestigiis pedum vestrorum vobis dabo eum. Quae sunt loca quae adscendimus? Legis littera humi posita est et deorsum iacet; nusquam adscendit qui legis litteram sequitur. Si potueris a littera adscendere ad spiritum et ab historia ad intellectum celsiorem, tunc vere adscendisti locum editum quem a Deo in hereditate percipies. Si typos intelligas et quae sursum sunt quaeras ubi Christus est in dextera Dei sedens, tunc illum locum percipies — Ubi ego sum, ibi erit et minister meus. Si usque ad Christum sedentem perveneris fide vita puritate virtute et vestigiis pedum quae lavit Iesus, dabit tibi eum Deus; tunc non solum heres Dei sed et coheres Christi.

pass_b_english: [[Every place you ascend with the soles of your feet I will give you >> Bible:Joshua 1:3]]. What places do we ascend? The letter of the law lies on the ground; whoever follows only the letter never ascends. If you can rise from letter to spirit and from history to a higher understanding, then you have truly climbed the high place you will receive from God as inheritance. If in what is written you discern types and [[seek the things above, where Christ is seated at God’s right hand >> Bible:Colossians 3:1]], you will receive that place — for our Lord says: [[Where I am, there will my servant be also >> Bible:John 12:26]]. If by faith, life, purity, and virtue you reach Christ seated at God’s right hand, and with those [[feet Jesus washed >> Bible:John 13:5]] you tread that place, God will give it to you; then you become not only [[God’s heir but Christ’s fellow-heir >> Bible:Romans 8:17]].
